profile.headline: Technical Program Manager | Software Engineer | Enterprise Platforms | Cloud & Digital Transformation | Financial Services | PMP
profile.geoLocationName: West New York, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
I’m a Technical Program Manager and Software Engineering professional with 7+ years of experience spanning software delivery, technology transformation, engineering, and program management across financial services, healthcare, technology, and industrial environments.
I specialize in leading complex, cross-functional technology programs from strategy and planning through execution and production delivery. My experience includes regulatory and compliance initiatives, customer onboarding, system migration, infrastructure modernization, enterprise application delivery, and operational transformation.
At JPMorganChase, I lead enterprise technology programs involving engineering, product, and infrastructure teams, with a focus on regulatory compliance, customer onboarding, program governance, risk management, UAT, and executive communication. Previously, at Humana and Santander, I worked across software engineering, system migration, infrastructure modernization, and technology delivery.
My background combines hands-on software engineering with PMP-certified program management and engineering leadership. This combination allows me to bridge business objectives, technology strategy, and execution—translating complex requirements into measurable outcomes while managing dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and delivery timelines.
I’m particularly interested in opportunities at the intersection of technology, engineering, AI-enabled transformation, cloud platforms, and enterprise-scale program delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer | TPM
positions.description:
•	Lead end-to-end delivery of regulatory compliance and customer onboarding programs, coordinating across multiple engineering and product teams.
•	Established program governance models (OKR tracking, milestone dashboards, risk registers) to improve cross-departmental visibility.
•	Partner with product and infrastructure leaders to define program scope, KPIs, and success metrics for enterprise banking initiatives.
•	Present program progress and risk updates to senior management and executive stakeholders, ensuring transparent delivery alignment.
•	Oversee UAT planning, dependency tracking, and risk mitigation to ensure successful, on-time releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer | TPM
positions.description:
•	Directed system migration and infrastructure modernization projects across healthcare platforms.
•	Designed and maintained disaster recovery plans, risk logs, and migration roadmaps aligned with compliance standards.
•	Collaborated with engineering, product, and operations to manage resources and milestone delivery.
•	Created training materials and onboarding guides to support operational readiness and adoption.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Partnered with product managers and architects to deliver new credit features using an Agile–Waterfall hybrid model.
•	Enhanced release predictability and reduced delivery cycle time by 10% through improved sprint planning and coordination.
•	Facilitated cross-team collaboration and implemented refined communication channels for project tracking.

positions.title: Associate Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed multiple software projects from requirements gathering through go-live and post-support phases.
•	Defined project plans, performance metrics, and stakeholder communication strategies for technology delivery.
•	Streamlined processes and improved delivery efficiency by implementing internal knowledge-sharing frameworks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed customer-facing software solutions for healthcare clients, emphasizing user experience and operational efficiency.
•	Coordinated testing, training, and client onboarding to ensure successful adoption and system performance.

positions.title: Project Manager / Industrial Engineer
positions.description:
•	Managed cross-border infrastructure and manufacturing projects valued at over $20M.
•	Led Lean process improvement and CapEx programs, achieving a 10% operational efficiency gain.
•	Supervised multicultural teams and developed metrics to track project execution and performance outcomes.
